sections.title: Jacob Misiorowski vs Tampa Bay Rays
sections.body: Jacob Misiorowski works mainly off a four-seam. He shows above-average swing-and-miss ability (regular-season rates). He shows solid command (regular-season rates). Jacob Misiorowski has allowed 14 home runs over 665 batters faced; no contact-risk rating is given because a home-run rate needs a far larger sample. This lineup hits well against RHP pitching (.751 OPS), so Jacob Misiorowski cannot live over the middle.

sections.title: Drew Rasmussen vs Milwaukee Brewers
sections.body: Drew Rasmussen works off a cutter-four-seam combination. He shows above-average swing-and-miss ability (regular-season rates). He shows solid command (regular-season rates). Drew Rasmussen has allowed 14 home runs over 669 batters faced; no contact-risk rating is given because a home-run rate needs a far larger sample. This lineup hits well against RHP pitching (.759 OPS), so Drew Rasmussen cannot live over the middle. They draw walks at an above-average rate, so Drew Rasmussen needs efficient strikes.
